# msl_origins (Data Source)

Lists MSL5 **Origins** (`/api/v1/origins`), optionally filtered by contract and group.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `contract_id` (String) Filter origins by Akamai contract ID.
- `group_id` (String) Filter origins by group ID.

### Read-Only

- `origins` (Attributes List) List of origins matching the specified filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--origins))

<a id="nestedatt--origins"></a>
### Nested Schema for `origins`

Read-Only:

- `account_id` (String) Account ID associated with the origin.
- `backup_ingest_location` (String) Backup ingest zone (empty string if not set).
- `contract_id` (String) Akamai contract ID.
- `cptag` (String) CP code tag.
- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 creation timestamp.
- `created_by` (String) User who created the origin.
- `group_id` (String) Group identifier.
- `host_name` (String) Unique hostname identifier.
- `id` (String) Origin ID.
- `ingest_location` (String) Primary ingest zone.
- `status` (String) Current status of the origin.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 last-updated timestamp.
